symptom: `create external entities from` over a contract whose entity set has FilterRestrictions Filterable=false, or NonFilterableProperties naming the key, built an app mx check rejected with one CE6630 "'Id' is marked Filterable=False in the OData service, but True in the app" per such entity. The key attribute's own Filterable was already false; every other property was right.
file: sdk/domainmodel RemoteKeyPart.NotFilterable; mdl/executor/cmd_contract.go (key parts get !entitySet.AttrFilterable(keyName)); mdl/backend/modelsdk/domainmodel_write.go odataKeyPartToGen (was SetFilterable(true)) and domainmodel.go odataKeyFromGen/storedKeyPartFilterable. Tests: cmd_contract_key_filterable_test.go, odata_key_filterable_test.go; fixture mdl-examples/bug-tests/key-filterable-from-contract.mdl + contracts/key-filterable-metadata.xml
cause: A Rest$ODataKeyPart carries its own Filterable beside the attribute's Rest$ODataMappedValue.Filterable, and mxbuild compares both with the service. The writer hard-coded the key part's to true, so the four earlier CE6630 fixes (set-level and property-list shapes of Filterable, Sortable, Top, Skip, Updatable) all set the attribute and none could reach the key part. The reader never read it, so a rewrite of a Studio Pro entity would also have flipped a stored false to true.
insight: **Five CE6630 records were the importer getting a capability wrong one term at a time; the efficient way to close the class was one contract per capability shape against the real build, not another report.** 13 shapes, one contract and one project each (whole set Sortable/Filterable=false, NonSortable/NonFilterableProperties naming the label or the key, TopSupported, SkipSupported, CountRestrictions, Insert/Update/DeleteRestrictions, no annotation): 11 clean, 2 CE6630 - both on the KEY and both Filterable. Sortable on the key was already fine, which is what pointed away from the contract parser (AttrFilterable and AttrSortable are the same shape) and at a field only the key has. A model field with a historic default needs a zero value that keeps the default: `NotFilterable` rather than `Filterable`, so every other builder of a key part is unchanged. The reader must not read an absent property as false (storedKeyPartFilterable defaults true), the same trap storedLocalizeDate documents. A hand-written `create external entity` is NOT a CE6630 gap worth a check: it produces CE6010 (no key), CE6612 on every attribute and Countable/Top/Skip mismatches whatever the contract says, so it is not a form that builds on its own. My first matrix also forgot ODataVersion: OData4 (CE6631 on everything) and used the reserved attribute name `Id` in a hand-written entity (CE7247); both were mine. Control: reverting the writer, the importer or the reader each fails its own tests (2, 3 and 1); the fixture gives 2 CE6630 with the pre-fix binary and 0 errors with the fixed one.
